title: Natural US30-US100 Book Drawdown Complementarity Audit
question: When either natural symbol book enters its own maximum 2x-cost stressed closed-drawdown episode, does the other book deliver positive and material stressed P/L during the same exact close-time interval broadly enough across four fresh periods to demonstrate portfolio drawdown complementarity?
hypothesis: The US30 and US100 strategy books express different market and strategy structures. If that difference is economically useful at portfolio level, each book should repeatedly offset a material part of the other book's worst native closed-loss episode rather than merely adding pooled net outside stress intervals.
why_now: After Units 043-049 allocated Programs 7→5→2→4→3→1→2, the whole-map comparison rejects adjacent signal and rates work and finds no clean nonadjacent Program 4 observable. Program 5 now has a broad untreated portfolio-interaction question that changes no lot, slot, priority, entry or exit rule: whether the two natural symbol books actually diversify each other's loss paths.

current_path_hash_manifest.algorithm: Sort root-relative path|uppercase file SHA-256, join with LF, SHA-256 UTF-8.

pre_outcome_feasibility.scope: Only immutable hashes, complete component identity, birth event and fresh period were used. No CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE value, stressed net, drawdown interval, counterbook offset, relief ratio, gate or verdict was accessed.

fixed_reconstruction.event_identity: Preserve every distinct full CSV row; state_sequence is not an event primary key.
fixed_reconstruction.ordering: Within each fresh period order by parsed server_time, numeric state_sequence, close-before-birth precedence, source path and source line for lifecycle integrity. Drawdown paths aggregate all closes at the same exact server_time before updating either book.
fixed_reconstruction.exact_component_selection: Use only the six complete component_id keys in strategy_identity. Prefix, suffix, substring, wildcard and inferred-family selectors are prohibited.
fixed_reconstruction.market_birth: OPEN begins RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure or Return and supplies positive planned risk from detail.
fixed_reconstruction.passive_pending: PASSIVE_PLACE stores positive planned risk; PASSIVE_EXPIRE clears it and PASSIVE_FILL begins Passive with the active risk.
fixed_reconstruction.close: CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE ends the active lifecycle; value_b is frozen 2x-cost stressed net USD.
fixed_reconstruction.book_close_path: For every distinct close server_time, sum value_b separately for US30_BOOK and US100_BOOK, then advance both cumulative book balances simultaneously from a zero period-start sentinel.
fixed_reconstruction.maximum_drawdown_episode: For the source book, initialize running peak to zero at PERIOD_START. Update the running peak only on a strictly higher cumulative value. At each close time after applying both books' aggregated closes, calculate peak minus current source cumulative. Select the largest drawdown; exact ties retain the earliest trough and the already-retained earliest peak.
fixed_reconstruction.episode_interval: The counterbook interval net is its cumulative balance at the selected trough minus its cumulative balance at the selected source-book peak. This includes closes strictly after the peak time through and including the trough time. A PERIOD_START peak uses zero counterbook balance.
fixed_reconstruction.offset_ratio: Counterbook interval net divided by the positive source-book maximum drawdown. Positive values offset source loss; negative values amplify it.
fixed_reconstruction.weighted_offset_ratio: Across four periods, sum counterbook interval net divided by sum positive source-book maximum drawdown.
fixed_reconstruction.positive_offset_contribution: For positive counterbook interval nets only, the largest period value divided by their sum.
fixed_reconstruction.full_book_diversification_relief: For each period, 1 minus full-portfolio maximum closed drawdown divided by the sum of US30 and US100 book maximum closed drawdowns. The weighted ratio uses summed full drawdowns and summed book drawdowns across periods.

fixed_bundle_health_gate: US30_BOOK and US100_BOOK each have strictly positive pooled stressed net.

Full-book diversification relief is at least 0.15 in at least three of four periods and its weighted four-period value is at least 0.15.

requirements: The source and counterbook each have at least one close strictly after the selected peak through the selected trough in every period.
Counterbook interval stressed net is strictly positive in at least three of four periods.
Offset ratio is at least 0.20 in at least three of four periods.
The four-period weighted offset ratio is at least 0.20.
The median of the four period offset ratios is at least 0.20.
No single period contributes more than 60% of summed positive counterbook interval net.
fixed_variant_gate.pass_rule: A variant passes only if every requirement and every bundle health gate passes. Zero is not positive and an episode with no counterbook close cannot pass density.
